testsuite.name: com.chromascape.web.debug.tickdebugger.controller.TickReplayControllerTest

testcase.name: Unified endpoint merges standard and tick logs with correct origins and ordering
Unified endpoint orders equal timestamps by origin then ID, surviving colliding IDs
Unified endpoint uses session scope when correlated logs exist and excludes other sessions
Unified endpoint returns standard logs even without a linked debug session
Unified endpoint preserves null ticks in standard logs
Unified endpoint returns an empty logs array when both repositories are empty
Unified endpoint never mixes correlated rows with unscoped fallback rows
Unified endpoint rejects invalid windowSeconds
Unified endpoint serializes logs as an empty array
Unified endpoint returns standard logs with origin=external and nullable tick
Unified endpoint returns 404 for an unknown recording
Unified endpoint clamps the window to the recording end time
Tick card summary displays correct position for flat worldX/worldY payload
recordingHealth_onlyQueriesRecordingLinkedSessions()
Unified endpoint returns the requested recordingId in the response
Unified endpoint uses recording scope when only recording-correlated logs exist
Tick card summary does not display fake zero position for non-numeric coordinates
Unified endpoint reports the correct scopeMode per mode
getTickCards_includesQuestHelperInSectionData()
Unified endpoint rejects negative videoTimeMs
Packet endpoint pages through the repository with limit+1
Unified endpoint falls back to timestamp scope for historical recordings
Unified endpoint returns 400 for a recording without a start time
Unified endpoint sorts equal timestamps deterministically by ID
Packet endpoint clears the cursor on the final page
Tick card summary displays correct position for flat x/z payload
Packet cursor follows source/schema/observation identity for interleaved v2 rows
Packet endpoint pushes the text filter into the repository query
